stage_goal: V1.2: freeze the controlled comparison protocol before first holdout execution
selection_reason: On dev only, 0.2 improved both dense providers from 0/10 to 10/10 Recall@3 and from 2/12 to 7/12 strict accuracy. Hybrid improved 7/12 to 8/12. Unknown false positives remain and are not hidden.
embedding: existing qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash configuration; independent clients and isolated indexes
engineering_gate: complete measurements without infrastructure errors or project/snapshot scope violations; keep all actual quality failures
quality_claim: descriptive small synthetic benchmark, no general production-quality threshold or winner assumed
cost_policy: actual reported usage; no price card supplied, monetary cost stays unknown
